    cols = len(grid[0])
    
    # Start with copy of grid (preserve noise for now)
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    
    for color in range(1, 10):

        positions = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) 
                     if grid[r][c] == color]
        
        if len(positions) < 5:
            continue
        
        # Get bounding box
        r_min = min(p[0] for p in positions)
        r_max = max(p[0] for p in positions)
        c_min = min(p[1] for p in positions)
        c_max = max(p[1] for p in positions)
        
        # Calculate box size
        height = r_max - r_min + 1
        width = c_max - c_min + 1
        area = height * width
        
        # Skip small regions (< 16 pixels)
        if area < 16:
            continue
        
        # Count color pixels in bounding box
        color_count = 0
        for r in range(r_min, r_max + 1):
            for c in range(c_min, c_max + 1):
                if 0 <= r < rows and 0 <= c < cols and grid[r][c] == color:
                    color_count += 1
